method: H2: restricted Hartree-Fock / H2+: exact one-electron diagonalization in minimal STO-3G basis
h2_rhf_warning: Restricted HF yields qualitatively incorrect dissociation for H2 due to static correlation; this is not bond-formation kinetics.
limitations: Born-Oppenheimer nuclei fixed for each distance
Minimal STO-3G basis, no electron correlation in H2
No time evolution, collision, radiation, third body or energy dissipation
Does not establish a chemical reaction rate or spontaneous bond formation
